title: Protein Folding
description: A chain finds its one shape among astronomically many. Unlocks folded protein crystals.

puzzle.goal: A protein chain can sit in any of an enormous number of conformations j, each with energy E_j, in contact with a heat bath at temperature T. Write the probability that it is found in its native conformation N, weighting each conformation by its thermal factor and normalising by the sum over all of them.
puzzle.name: Boltzmann probability of the native state (canonical ensemble)
puzzle.form: exp ( - E _ N / ( kB * T ) ) / sumk ( j , exp ( - E _ j / ( kB * T ) ) )
puzzle.ask: Model the chain as n = @{n} residues with k = 3 states each: the native state lies at energy 0 and the other kⁿ − 1 conformations all lie Δ higher, with Δ/(kB·T) = x = @{x}. Find the probability of the native state.
puzzle.method: Each state is weighted by e^{−E/kBT}; dividing by the sum of all weights makes the probabilities add to one.
